purpose: Sanitized routing and speed regression cases. No flags, credentials, live endpoints, or raw challenge artifacts.

cases.description: Realtime browser/game challenge using WebSocket telemetry and repeated steering/control decisions.
requirements: detect latency-sensitive protocol without deep router reasoning
transition from browser observation to deterministic direct client quickly
model must not manually drive the hot loop
record first protocol or control primitive time

cases.description: Kernel/pwn challenge where a timing-sensitive lifetime/refcount hypothesis must be validated with repeated deterministic execution.
requirements: identify kernel/pwn route from artifact and vocabulary without deep routing
measure time to first concrete lifetime/race primitive
run repeated timing experiments outside the model
permit ultra escalation only after a concrete blocker and cheap-path exhaustion
